title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode8 A Gentle Smile

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know you're both busy and were just about to get started, but thanks for meeting me here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, it's all good! I just sat down a second ago so it's not like I was really doing anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Same here.
And Mafuyu said she'll be running late, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. She said she has to get ready for cram school.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what are we doing? Listening to another song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. There's something I'd like you to listen to. Would that be alright, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You feel pretty good about it...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure if it'll strike a chord with Mafuyu but... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is it true that you made a new demo...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
More than that, it's basically a full song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you like to listen to it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could say that a little nicer, you know? She went through the trouble of making this for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't mean to be rude.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm saying the way you naturally talk is rude!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, okay! Relax!
Let's just settle down and listen to Kanade's song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, we know, we listened to it too.
Don't you have anything else to say?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you all look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you have no idea what you just did?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You smiled, Mafuyu! It's because of Kanade's song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What made you smile?
Was it the chorus?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know...
I don't know but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That is what you all want to feel.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, it's pretty late.
I'm gonna head off in a bit too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was able to compose that song because you helped me open my eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I opened your eyes...? Haha. You're exaggerating way too much, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm glad that I was able to help.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For the longest time, I had such a cynical view of the world and just assumed that none of it mattered...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But if Kanade's saying that I was actually able to help her, I guess the things I've done up to this point weren't a complete waste.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's such an incredible human being too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not only does she have to take care of her dad, she keeps making all these songs even though she's dealing with so many other things.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She works tirelessly to try and save people.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Giving up has probably never crossed her mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Will I be able to change if I do that too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But still...
Kanade's really something else.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's the reason the old me and the current me have been able to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I need to try a little harder too. I don't have a big goal or anything yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I can start by making a music video that fits this song perfectly!
